fields.q1: you felt so good or so hyper that other people thought you were not your normal self or you were so hyper that you got into trouble?
fields.q2: you were so irritable that you shouted at people or started fights or arguments?
fields.q3: you felt much more self-confident than usual?
fields.q4: you got much less sleep than usual and found you didn’t really miss it?
fields.q5: you were much more talkative or spoke faster than usual?
fields.q6: thoughts raced through your head or you couldn’t slow your mind down?
fields.q7: you were so easily distracted by things around you that you had trouble concentrating or staying on track?
fields.q8: you had much more energy than usual?
fields.q9: you were much more active or did many more things than usual?
fields.q10: you were much more social or outgoing than usual, for example, you telephoned friends in the middle of the night?
fields.q11: you were much more interested in sex than usual?
fields.q12: you did things that were unusual for you or that other people might have thought were excessive, foolish, or risky?
fields.q13: spending money got you or your family in trouble?
fields.q14: If you checked YES to more than one of the above, have several of these ever happened during the same period of time?
fields.q15: How much of a problem did any of these cause you — like being able to work; having family, money, or legal troubles; getting into arguments or fights?
fields.q16: Have any of your blood relatives (ie, children, siblings, parents, grandparents, aunts, uncles) had manic-depressive illness or bipolar disorder?
fields.q17: Has a health professional ever told you that you have manic-depressive illness or bipolar disorder?
